snippet.title: The Relic: First Guardian Release Date Trailer - PlayStation 5 and PC
snippet.description:
Take a fresh new look at The Relic: First Guardian! Featuring fast paced combat, formidable enemies, and an array of weapons and spells, get lost in the newest peek at what's to come.

Launches July 31st on PS5 & PC.

Also coming to Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 later this summer.
